pages.text: Loot boxes are right-click-to-open containers that drop a curated set of items from a specific loot table. They are earned through FTB Quests — completing additional quest paths beyond your required one always rewards a loot box.$(br2)$(bold)Six loot box tiers:$(/bold) Iron · Steel · Tier 3 · Tier 4 · Crucible · Mythic

pages.title: Iron Loot Box (T1)
pages.text: $(bold)Contents:$(/bold)$(br)2–4 Tier 1 tokens, 1–2 uncommon Apotheosis gems (flawed/chipped), 3–5 boss materials (Overworld-tier), 1 Common Apotheosis affix reforge token, 1–2 Iron's Spells scrolls (Tier 1)$(br2)$(bold)Earned by:$(/bold) Completing a non-required T1 quest path.

pages.title: Steel Loot Box (T2)
pages.text: $(bold)Contents:$(/bold)$(br)2–4 Tier 2 tokens, 1–2 normal/flawless gems, 3–5 Twilight/Aether boss materials, 1 Uncommon/Rare affix token, 1 Ars Nouveau spell recipe, 1 random Simply Swords unique (5% — low but possible)$(br2)$(bold)Earned by:$(/bold) Completing a non-required T2 quest path.

pages.title: Tier 3, 4, Crucible & Mythic
pages.text: $(bold)Tier 3 Box:$(/bold) T3 tokens, flawless/perfect gems, Cataclysm boss materials, Epic affix token, Refined Storage pattern$(br2)$(bold)Tier 4 Box:$(/bold) T4 tokens, perfect gems, end-tier boss materials, Legendary affix token$(br2)$(bold)Crucible Box:$(/bold) Mixed high-tier materials + guaranteed unique weapon(rift-sourced)$(br2)$(bold)Mythic Box:$(/bold) Rift Shards, endgame materials, chance at Mythic I–II infusion component
